title: Counterterms below fourth Wiener chaos cannot change the divergent vacuum column

chaos_boundary.projection: Let P_j be orthogonal Wiener-chaos projection and W_N=P_4 V_N Omega
chaos_boundary.low_counterterm: Every deterministic vacuum, linear, quadratic or cubic counterterm C_N has P_4 C_N Omega=0
chaos_boundary.consequence: The K1439 divergent fourth-chaos negative-form column is unchanged by every counterterm of chaos degree at most three
chaos_boundary.ceiling: Fourth-chaos, field-strength, momentum-dependent, singular-domain and non-Gaussian repairs remain open
